unauthorized_work: two-dimensional or three-dimensional R05 production solver

spatial: registered multiscale gap or composition mapping with measured transfer function
STEM-EDX or APT as destructive local-composition support with an exchangeability model
spectroscopy: cryogenic UHV STM/STS with spatially indexed spectra and a measured energy-resolution kernel
auxiliary: infrared mapping for wafer-scale region selection

principal_identifiability_risks: material correlation length confounded with spatial PSF or pixel integration
local variance confounded with filtering and finite-map bias
spatial and spectroscopy measurements taken from nonexchangeable specimens
tip-induced band bending and HgCdTe surface states mimicking low-energy DOS
spectroscopy resolution or background absorbing the correlated-versus-scalar difference
wafer tolerance incorrectly treated as local sigma_x

preliminary_public_data_result.interpretation: Source leads and facility capabilities exist, but PR1 found no open record already combining near-critical HgCdTe local covariance, measured spatial transfer information, matched low-energy local spectroscopy, same-population metadata, and raw calibration data. This is a preliminary specification-stage result, not the PR2 exhaustive audit.

frozen_conventions.g_threshold_interpretation: method-benchmark bracket; not a universal critical coupling

claim_boundary: No measured random-mass field is claimed.
No specimen-specific correlation length is claimed.
The g threshold is not universal.
Synthetic recovery is not material validation.
No topology, domain-wall transport, percolation, or mobility-edge claim is authorized.
